runtimeStatus.browserReporting: not used for declared server-side events
runtimeStatus.notes: Cedros Login emits declared server events through the Wasm telemetry emit-event seam with redacted metadata.

events.description: A user successfully authenticated through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a successful login, OAuth, wallet, WebAuthn, SSO, instant-link, or MFA-completed authentication flow returns an authenticated session.
events.ownerAction: Review authentication health and conversion by method without exposing direct identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after successful auth/session transitions.

events.description: A user account was created through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a new account is successfully committed through register, OAuth first-login, wallet first-login, WebAuthn signup, SSO first-login, or instant-link account creation.
events.ownerAction: Review registration volume and method mix without storing visitor identifiers in analytics.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after successful auth/session transitions.

events.description: A user session was ended through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after logout or logout-all successfully revokes a current session or all sessions and returns safe logout cookies.
events.ownerAction: Review logout volume and session security activity without exposing session identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after successful auth/session transitions.

events.description: A registration notification seed was created through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after registration completes and the team notification seed is queued with redacted metadata.
events.ownerAction: Review registration notification activity without exposing recipient or account identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after successful registration notification setup.

events.description: A login notification seed was created through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after login completes and the team notification seed is queued with redacted metadata.
events.ownerAction: Review login notification activity without exposing session or account identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after successful login notification setup.

events.description: An additional sign-in method was linked to an existing account through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after an authenticated user links an additional sign-in method (passkey, Google/Apple OAuth, password, Solana wallet) or changes the account email.
events.ownerAction: Review method-link adoption and account-security posture without exposing direct identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm link routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after the linked method is persisted (link-oauth, webauthn-register-verify, set-password, change-email, solana-link).

events.description: An additional identifier was removed from an existing account through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after an authenticated user removes a non-primary email identifier.
events.ownerAction: Review identifier removals without exposing direct identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm account email routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after the email row is removed.

events.description: A sign-in attempt was rejected before a session was issued through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record when an email/password sign-in attempt is rejected before a session is issued (unknown account, missing password, or wrong password — all reported as invalid-credentials for enumeration resistance).
events.ownerAction: Monitor failed sign-in volume and credential-stuffing spikes by method without exposing identifiers.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm login route calls host::telemetry::emit_event from record_failure when a password sign-in attempt is rejected.

events.description: An account was temporarily locked after repeated failed sign-in attempts through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record when a login is rejected because recent failed attempts for the email reached the lockout threshold within the lockout window.
events.ownerAction: See brute-force throttling engage and spot targeted or mass-lockout incidents.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm login route calls host::telemetry::emit_event when recent failures reach the lockout threshold (429 account_locked).

events.description: A rotated refresh token was replayed, signalling possible session theft, through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record when refresh detects reuse of an already-rotated refresh token, which revokes all of the user's sessions and alerts them.
events.ownerAction: Surface possible session-theft / account-takeover spikes that are otherwise buried in operational logs.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm refresh route calls host::telemetry::emit_event when an already-rotated refresh token is replayed.

events.description: A user turned on multi-factor authentication through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a user verifies a TOTP code and MFA (TOTP) is enabled on the account.
events.ownerAction: Track MFA adoption and account-security posture across the user base.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm mfa enable route calls host::telemetry::emit_event after the TOTP secret is enabled.

events.description: A user turned off multi-factor authentication through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a user re-verifies their password and MFA (TOTP) is removed from the account.
events.ownerAction: Watch for drops in MFA coverage that can indicate takeover attempts or a UX problem.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm mfa disable route calls host::telemetry::emit_event after the TOTP secret is removed.

events.description: A user requested a password-reset email through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record when forgot-password queues a reset email for an existing account; never fires for unknown accounts, preserving enumeration resistance.
events.ownerAction: Monitor password-recovery demand and takeover-probe spikes without leaking account existence.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm forgot-password route calls host::telemetry::emit_event after a reset email is queued for an existing account.

events.description: A user completed a password reset through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after reset-password validates and stores the new password hash and revokes all of the user's sessions.
events.ownerAction: Close the recovery funnel and review the forced session revocation that follows a reset.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm reset-password route calls host::telemetry::emit_event after the new hash is persisted and all sessions are revoked.

events.description: A user verified an email address through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a user proves control of an email address: signup verification, email change, additional-email verification, or a magic-link click.
events.ownerAction: Track the email-verification / activation funnel without exposing addresses.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm verify-email, account-emails-verify, and instant-link-verify routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after an email is proven verified.

events.description: A user account was deleted through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after an account is purged via the email-confirmed or typed-confirmation self-service deletion path.
events.ownerAction: Track deletion volume and path as the churn counterpart to registrations.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm account-deletion routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after the account is purged.

events.description: A team invitation was sent through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a team invite is committed (create or resend), carrying the recipient KIND and role but never the address.
events.ownerAction: See team-growth invite volume and the email-vs-wallet recipient mix.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm invite create and resend routes call host::telemetry::emit_event after the invite row is committed.

events.description: A team invitation was accepted through Cedros Login.
events.trigger: Record after a team invite is accepted and the membership is created in one atomic batch.
events.ownerAction: Complete the invite-acceptance funnel surfaced by the identity-health dashboard card.
events.browserReportingPath: No browser emission for this server-side event.
events.serverReportingPath: server-wasm invite accept route calls host::telemetry::emit_event after the membership batch commits.

stagingVerification: Build the Wasm component and run one login, one registration, one notification-seed, and one logout path in staging.
Confirm Cedros analytics joins each event id to the manifest displayName/category.
Inspect logs and analytics properties for absence of email, token, cookie, raw header, IP address, and raw provider payload values.
